lines.cyr: Какво пусто време дојде, се одродивме,
lines.lat: Kakvo pusto vreme dojde, se odrodivme,
lines.en: What a desolate time has come, we have lost our ways,

lines.cyr: брат од брата да се делат, да не се видат,
lines.lat: brat od brata da se delat, da ne se vidat,
lines.en: brothers are separated from brothers, not to see each other,
mothers and fathers are not taken care of,
everyone sells everything they can.
Hey Christian brothers, wake up,

lines.cyr: родни куќи, родна земја не продавајте,
lines.lat: rodni kuḱi, rodna zemja ne prodavajte,
lines.en: don't sell your houses, your native land,

lines.cyr: арам пари, нема среќа, не се живее.
lines.lat: aram pari, nema sreḱa, ne se živee.
lines.en: that money is no good, there is no happiness in it.

lines.cyr: Ќе ве колнат ваши внуци, паравнуци,
lines.lat: Ḱe ve kolnat vaši vnuci, paravnuci,
lines.en: Your grandchildren, great-grandchildren will curse you,

lines.cyr: што за тие пусти пари, сè продадовте.
lines.lat: što za tie pusti pari, sè prodadovte.
lines.en: that for money, you sold everything.
Hey Christian brothers, wake up,
again (enemy) eyes are hovering over the Balkans,

lines.cyr: пак ли фесче ќе не шијат,
lines.lat: pak li fesče ḱe ne šijat,
lines.en: again they will want to sew us a fez,
day and night they are preparing,
they are waiting for the right time to destroy us,
hey, wake up.

lines.cyr: И во турско тешко било, се дочувало,
lines.lat: I vo tursko teško bilo, se dočuvalo,
lines.en: Under the Ottomans it was also difficult,

lines.cyr: чест и вера православна со крв се бранела,
lines.lat: čest i vera pravoslavna so krv se branela,
lines.en: honor and Orthodox faith were defended with blood,
mothers and fathers were respected as saints,
they protected the people.
Hey Christian brothers, wake up,

lines.cyr: А од сега, мили боже, клетва нека е:
lines.lat: A od sega, mili bože, kletva neka e:
lines.en: And from now on, dear God, let it be a curse:

lines.cyr: кој продаде родна земја, арам да му е,
lines.lat: koj prodade rodna zemja, aram da mu e,
lines.en: whoever sells his native land, may it be in vain,
from that empty, damned money,
let him only build tombs.
